title: Feeling like you're still "stuck there" after waking up
content: Might be an odd question, but its something I really struggle with. Does anyone ever feel like they're straddling the line between mallworld and our world when they wake up? By that, I mean when I have mallworld dreams, I wake up *physically feeling* like part of me is still "stuck there". It's a very odd visceral feeling at a nervous system level. Best I can describe it is the G-force from a fancy elevator that ascends way too quickly, but that "woah" feeling doesn't end. Or when you swim up from the deep end of a pool and there's some drag on your skin from the surface tension of the water. It's like that, but more internal, and only on one side of your... energy body? I have no idea how else to explain it, and this probably sounds wild to people who don't do somatic therapy/energy work/etc.. but yeah. Have you experienced this? Like something inside of you is still stuck there, and you have to wait for them to "wake up too"? Or help them slowly ease into waking consciousness?
